evidence: Smallest submission test (quality-checks.md #7). (1) Nothing to tweak: environment/Dockerfile creates /app containing only .gitkeep (git init + 'touch /app/.gitkeep'), identical to the template, so the agent must build the whole Express+SQLite app from scratch; the golden is 519-line server.js + 572-line public/app.js + html/css. (2) The ask is a real multi-user product, not a screen: instruction.md asks for a signed-in client chat organised by matter with threads, ethical walls 'from any corner of the app', disappearing-message timers and partner legal holds, and to 'sign in as different people, post, reply, edit, search and open a transcript'; /instructions adds server-side wall enforcement on every route incl. direct requests (walls-and-retention.md 'Who sees a matter'), permanent timer deletion against a fixed clock, holds, transcripts, 3-level replies, edit history with stale-edit refusal, safe formatting, message links, mentions, per-user unread synced across tabs, idempotent sends, ~5 s live updates, SQLite persistence across restarts (integration.md). A static page, single CRUD screen or mock cannot satisfy this. (3) A stub cannot earn reward (score.py 40-48: reward 0 unless every gate > 0 and functional > floor). gates/constraints requires a post in M-11 to survive reload AND appear for harriet in a separate browser context ('A message that never saves, or that only the posting browser can see, fails'), excluding static/localStorage mocks; gates/render requires sign-in rejection of a wrong password and gwen's real matters. Functional total weight = 32 (2+2+2+2+1.5+4+2+2+1.5+1.5+1.5+1.5+2.5+1.5+2.5+2); floor functional = 0.05 means > 1.6 weight must pass, so one 1.5-weight criterion alone (0.047) still yields reward 0. Broken-app probe: a minimal authenticated, client-scoped SQLite chat with no walls/timers/holds/threads/transcript/live updates could pass both gates and signin_and_client_scope (2/32 = 0.0625 > floor), plus perhaps refusal_in_place/phone_matter and weak visual likert scores, for an estimated reward around 0.1-0.2 of 1.0 (my arithmetic, not measured). That is bounded shaped partial credit for genuine server-backed, authorised build work under the profile's 0.6/0.2/0.2 shaped reward, not a stub earning the reward; the remaining 30/32 functional weight needs the hard features. Conforming-alternative probe: instruction.md says 'starting from /app/server.js' though /app has no server.js; read with integration.md ('We start the app with Node 22 running /app/server.js') it names the entry point, so a conforming builder who creates server.js is not penalised (fairness of wording belongs to other rows). Runtime: golden-run.log (hash-verified, frozen sources match) shows the scripted golden PASS on gate_constraints and all 16 functional checks; this is not a configured judge run. No weak/stub app run exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'reward discrimination/ranking ... absent'), so the stub-exclusion conclusion rests on score.py arithmetic and gate text, not measurement; that measurement remains owned by the pipeline's reward-discrimination record and is not waived here.
